'''Matt Gough''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Rochester tournament (30 September)]] on 30 September 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Rops Trooper deck]], according to Jake Rich's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1282">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-30-mellinieum-games-9-30-00d1282/ mellinieum-games-9-30-00], DeckTech (Jake "NeDraco" Rich, 30 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-30-mellinieum-games-9-30-00d1282/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
